job_title: Quản Lý Xuất- Nhập Khẩu/ Import-Export Manager
sub_category: Quản lý xuất nhập khẩu và thông quan
industry: Sản xuất linh kiện điện tử
location: Lô B3, KCN Bá Thiện II, Xã Bình Xuyên (Xã Bình Xuyên thuộc huyện Bình Xuyên cũ), Phú Thọ
qualifications: University degree or higher in Logistics, Import-Export, International Trade, Economics, or a related field
technical_skills: Experience working with SAP/ERP is an advantage
description:
- Manage and supervise all import, export and customs clearance activities, ensuring timely clearance and compliance with Vietnamese customs regulations.
- Review and control import/export customs declarations, HS codes, customs valuation, C/O, import/export duties and applicable product policies.
- Monitor and control customs procedures for raw materials, components, machinery/equipment, finished goods, returned goods, re-export, scrap and other special transactions.
- Manage and reconcile import – export – inventory data, BOM and material consumption data for customs compliance and annual customs finalization.
- Prepare, review and control customs reports, supporting documents and reconciliation data to ensure consistency between customs records, warehouse records and ERP/SAP data.
- Manage compliance requirements related to AEO, customs post-clearance audits and other inspections by Customs Authorities.
Identify and manage customs and import/export compliance risks; promptly report significant issues and propose corrective/preventive actions.
- Work directly with Customs Authorities and coordinate responses, explanations and document submissions during customs inspections or audits.
- Manage and monitor the performance of customs brokers, forwarders and logistics service providers related to customs clearance activities
- Coordinate closely with Warehouse, Purchasing, Production, Finance/Accounting and other relevant departments to resolve import/export and customs issues.
- Establish, maintain and improve customs clearance and import/export control procedures to strengthen compliance and internal controls.
Manage, train and support team members; assign tasks and monitor work progress and accuracy.
- Perform other import/export and customs-related duties as assigned by management.
requirements_text:
- University degree or higher in Logistics, Import-Export, International Trade, Economics, or a related field
- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Import/Export and Customs Clearance, preferably in an EPE manufacturing company.
- Hands-on experience in customs compliance, inventory reconciliation, BOM/material management and customs audits is strongly preferred.
- Experience in a team leader/supervisory or managerial role is preferred.
- Proficient in Excel; experience working with SAP/ERP is an advantage.
- Foreign languages: English/Korean.
